             for c in sep_cols[:-1]] for r in sep_rows[:-1]]

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(background) <= w // 2]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) <= h // 2]
    line_color = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows
                         for c in sep_cols if grid[r][c] != background).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(sep_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(sep_cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[sep_rows[ri]][sep_cols[ci]], grid[sep_rows[ri]][sep_cols[ci+1]],
                       grid[sep_rows[ri+1]][sep_cols[ci]], grid[sep_rows[ri+1]][sep_cols[ci+1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] != line_color else background)
        out.append(row)
    while out and all(x == background for x in out[-1]): out.pop()
    while out and all(row[-1] == background for row in out):
        for row in out: row.pop()
    return out
'''
path.write_text(program); exec(compile(program,str(path),'exec'),globals())
